newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent marked higher, NYMEX edges up.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent marked higher, NYMEX edges up.

text.p: June Brent was marked slightly firmer at midday in Asia in an adjustment to the close on NYMEX overnight.
June Brent on SIMEX was quoted at $18.07/$18.14 per barrel, compared with London's settlement overnight at $18.06.
Brokers said Brent was slightly higher in line with a modestly firm tone on ACCESS, where NYMEX June crude last traded at $19.75, up two cents from its New York close.
Brokers said the markets had absorbed the latest API data, released on Tuesday, so were looking for fresh direction from London later.
They said technically, Brent was still range trading with the front-position locked between $17.54 and $18.35.
